speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: asked the Minister for Transport (a) what is the current traffic speed along the Central Expressway (CTE) between 6.00 pm and 7.00 pm; (b) what is the purpose of having an evening ERP along CTE; and (c) whether the Ministry will consider removing this evening ERP.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: With the completion of the interchange, that means there is a new exit from CTE to Seletar West Link.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Many of the residents use the exit there and, so, there is an alternative for them.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: The observation from the residents is that the speed along the CTE actually has eased because you have an additional interchange linking the three expressways.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: And that is why we are hoping for the monitoring of the speed again since the opening of the new interchange and see whether or not we can remove the evening ERP.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: In fact, the Member used to be my Member of Parliament and a very good one.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: I always say, "My favourite Member of Parliament – Er Dr Lee Bee Wah." She was my Member of Parliament two general elections ago, but because of the boundary changes, she is no longer my Member of Parliament.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: And there is a reason for it – because she always conveys very strong feedback from the residents, like the case of CTE and ERP.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: I had open heart surgery more than five years ago.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: Since then, I have to face my cardiologist regularly.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: In fact, I will be seeing him tomorrow.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: A few days before each consultation, I will have to do a fasting blood test.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: Each time, I hope that my bad cholesterol reading will be in the optimal range so that the doctor can remove the very high dosage of statin that he prescribes for me.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: Last year, when I went for my consultation, my results were better than the preferred range, which is very aggressive: LDL must be below 1.8 mmol/l and mine was 1.7.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: So, I said, "Doctor, this time round, you can remove it".

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: It may go up again." So, same dosage.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: This time round, I got back my blood results a few days ago.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: So, I am keeping my fingers crossed that, hopefully, the very aggressive dosage will not be raised further.

speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
text: Anti-cholesterol drug is the same thing as ERP.
